Enterprise Account Executive

Autodesk is seeking an Enterprise Account Executive to strategically grow and expand relationships across high-value enterprise accounts. This role is responsible for leading comprehensive account growth strategies, driving incremental revenue, expanding product adoption, and positioning Autodesk as a long-term strategic partner to customers undergoing digital transformation.
The Enterprise Account Executive will own strategic executive relationships, account planning, revenue generation, pipeline management, complex deal negotiations, and orchestration of cross-functional account teams. This role goes beyond execution: it requires the ability to refine and innovate account strategies, influence executive stakeholders, lead high-complexity commercial motions, and drive measurable business outcomes for both Autodesk and the customer.
This role is suited for an experienced enterprise sales leader who can operate with senior decision-makers, navigate complex customer organizations, lead matrixed teams, and create scalable growth opportunities across EBA and non-EBA enterprise accounts.

Strategic Account Growth
Lead and refine comprehensive growth strategies for assigned enterprise accounts, including EBA and non-EBA customers
Develop multi-year strategic account plans aligned to customer priorities, Autodesk growth objectives, and long-term value creation
Identify and pursue expansion opportunities across new business units, buyer groups, personas, and use cases
Drive buyer seat expansion and product adoption across complex customer organizations
Lead QBRs, executive check-ins, and senior stakeholder engagement to review progress, business outcomes, risks, and future growth opportunities
Innovate account strategies that create scalable growth models and influence broader business outcomes
Revenue Generation & Pipeline Management
Maximize incremental revenue through upsell, cross-sell, upgraded products, new offerings, and EBA token consumption strategies
Own pipeline development, pipeline health, and forecasting accuracy for growth, expansion, and renewal opportunities
Use data-driven insights to assess account potential, customer spend trends, adoption signals, whitespace, and risk
Proactively adjust account tactics based on customer priorities, market changes, competitive dynamics, and business goals
Deliver predictable revenue performance while identifying transformational opportunities that support long-term customer and Autodesk growth
Executive Relationship Management
Build and maintain strategic relationships with C-level executives, senior decision-makers, and key influencers across assigned accounts
Adapt communication style to diverse executive audiences and manage challenging conversations with confidence, empathy, and business relevance
Act as a trusted advisor by connecting Autodesk capabilities to the customer’s strategic objectives and transformation priorities
Develop compelling executive narratives that articulate business value, ROI, competitive differentiation, and long-term partnership opportunities
Secure and maintain executive sponsorship for strategic initiatives, commercial agreements, and expansion opportunities
Complex Deal Strategy & Commercial Execution
Lead complex enterprise negotiations, including expansions, renewals, multi-year agreements, and high-value commercial structures
Build value-based business cases that quantify customer impact and support executive decision-making
Navigate procurement, commercial, legal, and stakeholder complexity to progress opportunities and mitigate risk
Mentor teams in complex deal negotiations and help shape strategic deal approaches across large enterprise opportunities
Account Team Unit / Cross-Functional Orchestration
Strategically lead partnerships with the extended sales team, Technical Sales, Customer Success, Consulting, Marketing, Partner teams, and executive stakeholders
Orchestrate the Account Team Unit to co-develop scalable, impactful customer solutions
Align technical discovery, messaging, value proposition, and commercial strategy to customer needs
Drive accountability across internal teams through clear ownership, communication, and execution cadence
Ensure seamless post-sale handoff to Customer Success for onboarding, implementation, adoption, and ongoing relationship management
Serve as an escalation point for customer challenges and internal alignment issues
Partner with Customer Success and Consulting teams to ensure customers achieve measurable business outcomes from Autodesk solutions
Industry, Competitive & Business Leadership
Maintain deep knowledge of the customer’s industry, business model, transformation priorities, competitive landscape, and regulatory environment
Translate industry challenges into tailored Autodesk solutions and differentiated value propositions
Provide customer and market insights to internal Sales, Product, Strategy, and Marketing teams
Influence Autodesk’s go-to-market approach by sharing enterprise customer needs, competitive intelligence, and emerging market opportunities
Represent Autodesk as a strategic thought partner in executive-level customer conversations

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience
10+ years of enterprise sales, strategic account management, or consultative business development experience
Proven success managing complex enterprise accounts and driving significant revenue growth
Experience engaging C-level executives and senior stakeholders across large, matrixed customer organizations
Demonstrated ability to lead complex commercial negotiations, renewals, expansions, and multi-year enterprise agreements
Strong track record of pipeline generation, forecast accuracy, and revenue attainment
Experience leading cross-functional account teams, including Technical Sales, Customer Success, Consulting, Marketing, Partner, Legal, Finance, and Deal Desk stakeholders
Strong business acumen, analytical thinking, executive communication, and consultative selling skills

Experience in enterprise SaaS, cloud, platform, digital transformation, or technology solution sales
Familiarity with Autodesk’s Architecture, Engineering, and Construction customer segments and the business challenges, workflows, and digital transformation priorities within the AECO industry
Experience leading strategic customer transformations, large-scale adoption programs, or executive-sponsored growth initiatives
Advanced skills in value-based selling, ROI modeling, business case development, and executive storytelling
Experience using Salesforce or similar CRM and account planning tools
Experience mentoring account teams or influencing sales strategy beyond assigned accounts

About ElevenLabs
ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.
We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $11B - multiples of 11, always.

s.h: We have expanded from voice into three main platforms
s.t:
ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.
ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.
ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.
Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.
How we work
High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.
Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.
AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.
Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.
Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.
Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.
Learning & development : ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.
Social travel : We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.
Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.
Co-working : If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

Decile Group () is the leading agentic platform for fund administration. Our AI-native infrastructure lets emerging managers launch, run, and scale a VC fund without the overhead that used to make it impossible. We just closed two record-breaking quarters back to back.

Hundreds of managers have launched on our platform, and the pipeline keeps accelerating. Every fund admin platform your prospects have heard of was built before the agentic era. They run on manual reconciliation, junior staff, and siloed systems that don't talk to each other.

Their clients get slow K-1s, surprise invoices, and a back office that runs like it's 2015.
Decile was built differently. One data layer across legal, compliance, treasury, accounting, and LP management. AI handles the heavy lifting. Ultra-senior staff on every account. K-1s delivered in March when everyone else is still working on theirs in May. Institutional-grade operations at emerging manager scale.
Your prospects are out there funding AI companies. Their own operations should run like one. Decile is built for 2026 and beyond. That's the story you get to tell.
Scam Warning
VC Lab and Decile Group never conduct hiring interviews via chat, and we will never ask candidates to send money, purchase equipment, or share financial information. Scammers may impersonate real employee names. If you are contacted about a role outside our official channels, do not engage. The role
You own a territory. You find emerging fund managers, show them what a modern fund operation actually looks like, and close them. Full sales cycle, no handoffs, uncapped commission.
The product line runs from Start Fund for first-time managers to full migrations for funds ready to move off legacy platforms. Migrations are the highest-value deals and close at near 100%. Self-sourced deals earn a bonus on top of the base rate.
We just closed two record-breaking quarters. The market is moving our way.

You will be on the front lines of a genuine market shift. Every day you are talking to GPs who are running their funds on platforms built before AI existed, paying too much, getting too little, and in many cases not even knowing a better option exists.
Your job is to find them, wake them up, and bring them over.
You prospect hard, get GPs on the phone, and show them what it looks like when a fund runs the way the companies they invest in actually run. You own the full cycle from cold outreach to signed contract. No committee, no handoffs. When you close, you close.

You know the VC and emerging manager ecosystem. You understand fund structures, what GPs actually deal with day to day, and why a back office that runs badly is a real problem.
You are genuinely agentic. You build your own pipeline, use every tool available including AI, and figure out what works without waiting to be told. You have probably been a first sales hire somewhere or built something yourself.
How to Apply: We’re seeking exceptional sales performers with venture capital experience who are ready to make an impact. Even if you don’t check every box, we encourage you to apply if you’re excited about our mission and believe you can excel in this role. Please submit your resume and a brief statement (200 words or less) explaining why your venture capital experience makes you uniquely qualified to drive Decile Group’s growth. A Day-in-a-Life of our Business Development ManagerÂ
As a Business Development Manager at EatClub, you will spend most of your time out in the market, meeting venue owners, building relationships, and growing the platform one partnership at a time.
Your territory is yours to build. You'll be walking into restaurants, calling operators, and scheduling meetings with the venues you believe will thrive on the platform. Some days start with mapping the neighbourhoods you want to focus on, identifying the venues that fit the product best, and planning how you'll approach them.
Most of your day is spent face-to-face with restaurant owners and managers. You're introducing EatClub, explaining how the platform works, and helping operators see how it can drive more customers through their doors.

Conversations move quickly - some venues sign up after one conversation, others take a few follow-ups - but momentum matters and your pipeline moves fast. Average time from first walk-in to signed agreement is under two weeks. You are not waiting on approval chains - you close and move on to the next one.
Between meetings, you're updating your pipeline, following up with prospects, and preparing for the next round of conversations.
You'll also work closely with the broader EatClub team, sharing insights about the local hospitality market, feeding back what venue owners are saying, and helping refine how we approach new cities as we expand across the AU.
This role suits someone who thrives working independently, does not need a manager to tell them what to do next, and gets genuine satisfaction from seeing a number on a board they built themselves.

Sprinto is an Autonomous Trust Platform that centralizes trust requirements across security frameworks, vendors, and customers.
Sprinto autonomously executes tasks needed to maintain trust across compliance, audits, risk management, vendor risk, privacy, and AI governance, enabling organizations to maintain a strong, reliable trust posture without draining operational bandwidth and resources on repetitive tasks.
Backed by top-tier investors such as Accel, Elevation, and Blume Ventures, we’ve raised $31.8M in funding to fuel our mission. Trusted by over 4,000 organizations across 75 countries , Sprinto helps organizations stay audit-ready, manage real-time risks, and scale fearlessly.

With 300+ native integrations and AI-driven automation, Sprinto supports 200+ global security standards natively , including SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, and more. Sprinto 's extensible architecture enables organizations to build and support an infinite number of custom integrations and frameworks.
Founded in 2020 by second-time founders Girish Redekar and Raghuveer Kancherla, Sprinto powers compliance for organizations like Whatfix, Encora, Anaconda, Whatnot, Ultrahuman, WeWork, Everstage, AI Foundation, HackerRank, and many more.
Life as a Sprinter -
Nobody succeeds at Sprinto by staying in their lane.
We are organized around problems, not job titles. Sprinters take ownership beyond their role, solve hard problems, and care deeply about the impact they create. If something can be improved, fixed, or built, we don't wait for permission; we step in.
Being remote means we rely less on proximity and more on trust. We write things down, communicate openly, and move quickly because great teams aren't built by sitting together, they're built by pulling in the same direction.
We believe progress beats perfection, feedback is a gift, and doing the right thing matters, even when nobody is watching.
And while we move with urgency, we never move alone.
The mission -
Sprinto is building the next phase of its outbound sales engine and this isn't a traditional SDR role.
You'll own a Target Account List of US-based mid-market and enterprise companies and run the full outbound motion to get the right GRC buyers in front of our Account Executives. Your mission is simple: map the accounts, find the right people, start meaningful conversations, and consistently create pipeline that turns into revenue.
You'll partner closely with an Account Executive carrying a $400K–$600K quota, working on enterprise deals averaging $30K–$60K ACV. You won't just hand over leads—you'll stay close to the deals you create, gaining first-handff exposure to how complex enterprise sales are won.
If you're looking for a role that teaches you how to think like an enterprise seller and not just book meetings, this is where that journey begins.
Where you'll leave your mark?
Own a high-volume Launch portfolio — renewals, upsells, and day-to-day relationships across a large book of startup and early-stage SMB accounts, prioritising by risk and value rather than treating every account the same way.
Run the renewal pipeline end to end — track renewals well ahead of expiry, forecast accurately , and close on time; a slow renewal is the fastest way to lose a low-touch account.

Negotiate commercial terms with confidence — pricing, discounts, and contract length, knowing when to hold firm and when to flex, especially on multi-year commitments.
Spot and close expansion opportunities — accounts ready to add frameworks (SOC 2 to ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA) or upgrade plans, pitched naturally within renewal conversations.
Get ahead of payment and billing risk — step in early on failed payments or lapsed billing before it turns into churn, one of the biggest causes of loss in this segment.

Work the system, not just the relationship — use CRM workflows, templates, and playbooks to manage volume efficiently, keeping renewal stage, risk flags, and outcomes logged in real time.
Partner cross-functionally with Customer Success, Sales, Finance, and the audit team to unblock renewals, resolve billing disputes, and report regularly on portfolio health .

s.h: The kind of builder we're looking for -
s.t:
2–4 years in account management, customer success, renewals, or sales, ideally in SaaS — experience in security, compliance, or GRC software is a plus, not a requirement.
A confident, direct negotiator — comfortable discussing price and terms without getting defensive or over-discounting.

Strong organisational discipline — able to juggle a large number of accounts at different stages without letting things slip, working off dashboards and structured playbooks rather than ad hoc outreach.
A clear, concise communicator , written and verbal — this is fast, high-volume outreach, not long relationship-building calls.

Analytical enough to read account data — usage, payment status, renewal date — and decide what to prioritise each day.

Resilient and proactive — comfortable with pushback, price objections, and the occasional lost account, and flags risk before it shows up in a report.

Curious about compliance and security — or willing to get up to speed quickly on SOC 2 and ISO 27001 to be a credible main point of contact for lean teams without their own compliance staff.

How we care for our Sprinters?

Work wherever you are : We are 100% remote, so you get to choose if you want to work from home, a cafe, the hills, or the beach.

Co-working, on the house : If co-working is your jam, we offer a generous annual allowance.

We care about your learning : We are invested in seeing you grow and commit USD 1,000 annually to help you level up your skills.

We count your spark, not your leaves : Unlimited leave so you can reset when you need to.

Your Safety Net, Woven In: Health insurance with coverage up to INR 10 lakh for you and your family, accident protection of an additional INR 10 lakh, and life insurance worth 3x your annual salary.

Workspace setup of your dreams : We chip in INR 35,000 to help you build a setup that works for you.

Inclusion & Diversity -
At Sprinto , talent, curiosity, and ownership matter more than where you come from. We hire people for the problems they can solve, the impact they create, and the way they help others succeed—not their background, identity, or personal circumstances. We believe the best teams are built when people with different perspectives come together around a shared ambition to build something meaningful.
We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a fair, inclusive, and accessible hiring process for everyone.

You will collaborate closely with regional sales and marketing teams, develop targeted commercial plans for academic and research markets, and build trusted relationships with institutional stakeholders, PIs, core directors, and scientific staff.
This is a remote position, with flexibility to work from any location in the US ( with preference to west coast US)

Identify and pursue new business opportunities across academic departments, shared resource facilities, government labs, and pharma research organizations.
Generate and qualify leads through scientific networking, campus visits, conferences, workshops, and digital outreach.

Develop and execute strategies to broaden adoption of bioanalytical technologies in research-intensive organisations.
Maintain an accurate sales pipeline and provide reliable forecasting for the target customer segment.
Sales Support
Collaborate with regional sales and marketing teams to convert academic and research opportunities into orders.
Support the sales process through technical presentations, workflow discussions, demonstrations, and proposal/quote negotiation.

Develop and implement sales plans tailored to academic funding cycles, grant landscapes, and institutional priorities.
Set and monitor target performance to ensure goals aligned with the Annual Operating Plan (AOP) are achieved or exceeded.

Collect and communicate customer insights, research challenges, and success stories to guide commercial strategy.

Communicate technical and workflow advantages effectively to scientific audiences with varying levels of expertise.
Product Development Input
Capture feedback from researchers, core facility staff, and field sales teams to support ongoing refinement of bioanalytical solutions.
Cross‑Functional Collaboration
Partner with sales, marketing, product management, and the broader Waters Analytical Science business segment to deliver cohesive, research-focused solutions to customers.

Bachelor’s degree in a lifescience related‑ field.

Ability to motivate and influence cross-functional teams.

Deep understanding of liquid chromatography, mass spectrometry, and flow cytometry as applied to academic, Pharmaceutical Discovery and translational research.

Willingness to travel up to 50% for campus visits, seminars, conferences, customer meetings, and team activities.

Reports directly to the Pharma lead within the LCMS Business Segment in the Analytical Sciences Division

Our systems help the teams responsible for national security read a complex information environment faster and clearer than ever before. We've closed a pre-seed round and are already running live government pilots, with plans to expand across Europe and beyond. This is an early, venture-backed company doing work that carries weight.

This is a founding role for our expansion across the DACH region and the Nordics. You will own how we grow here, from the first conversation through to a signed contract, building the region much as we built the UK: learning the landscape, opening doors, landing pilots and turning them into long-term contracts.

You will work closely with the founders and with a forward-deployed engineer who builds the tools, integrations and prototypes that a live sales process needs, so your job is to win the room, work out what the customer actually needs, and direct that build until the deal closes.

Own go-to-market across the DACH region and the Nordics, winning and growing contracts across government, defence and large enterprise, from first conversation through to close.
Map the region from a blank slate, find the advisory relationships that open doors, and build a network where we do not have one yet.
Land pilots and turn them into long-term contracts, working from first engagements towards enterprise deals worth seven figures a year.
Turn customer needs into scoped solutions, briefing and directing a forward-deployed engineer to stand up the reports, dashboards, integrations and prototypes that move deals forward.
Build the regional playbook from first principles: pipeline, qualification, pricing and close.
Make complex technology clear and convincing to senior decision-makers in government and defence.
Work directly with the founders on strategy, positioning and the deals that matter most.

You are, at heart, someone who likes to build something from nothing. You are at your best finding the first contacts, earning their trust, and turning a cold market into real relationships and real deals. You are hands-on, as comfortable doing the sourcing and outreach yourself as sitting across from a senior decision-maker on a sensitive brief, and you understand that this kind of work is slow, careful and built on trust.
A real appetite for business development: you like winning deals, opening relationships and building a market from scratch, and you keep going long after an inherited network has run dry.
Enough of a technical background to scope solutions, brief an engineer and hold your own with technical buyers.
The drive to build a process from nothing rather than run one that already exists.
Fluency in the region: strong English and at least one relevant regional language, with German a clear advantage.
Comfort in an early startup, where there is real ownership, quick decisions and plenty of ambiguity.
Discretion and integrity, because our work depends on a high level of trust.
A background in defence, national security or another setting where you have earned trust and done deals with government is a strong advantage.
Eligibility for security clearance is an advantage.

This is a launching role with a whole region to own, at an early, venture-backed company that has already closed a pre-seed round and is running live pilots with government. You will work alongside the founders, with founder-level access and ownership from the start, and the market you build will be yours to shape.

The work is demanding and it matters, for clients operating at a high level on problems that are genuinely difficult. For the person who builds this well, there is meaningful equity and real upside.

Business Development Managers (BDMs) play a critical role in creating early-stage pipeline and advancing opportunities within enterprise provider accounts. The BDMs will engage in omnichannel lead generation—email, LinkedIn, and administrative calling—to activate cold or stalled accounts, warm target personas, and secure meaningful early conversations. They will partner closely with AVPs to tailor account-based programs for priority systems, execute targeted plays using solution-specific Sales Playbooks, and ensure exit criteria are met to progress opportunities.
This individual partners closely with Sales, Marketing, and Product teams to gather discovery insights, build relationship maps, capture exit-criteria–aligned intel, and drive early traction that sets AVPs up for success.
This is a high-impact, visible role for someone who is persistent, operationally excellent, highly organized, and comfortable navigating complex provider organizations.

Opportunity Advancement (Primary Focus)
Own the early-stage advancement of opportunities from Qualify → Discovery, and as proficiency grows, Discovery → Evaluation.
Execute solution-specific Sales Playbooks to ensure all exit criteria are met before handoff.
Capture and document discovery answers (via email, prep, or call notes) to support progression.
Execute warm handoffs of qualified opportunities to AVPs with complete and accurate context.
Omnichannel Outbound & Lead Generation
Run multi-channel outreach across email, LinkedIn, and administrative calling to activate early interest and secure meetings.
Engage cold accounts or pre-qualified accounts to generate first conversations for AVPs from Ideal Customer Persona (ICP) accounts
Conduct inbound lead triage and fast follow-up for prospects engaging with marketing assets or events.
Call clinical and operational office lines or executive assistants to schedule meetings and coordinate access.
Account-Based Engagement & Territory Support
Partner with AVPs to tailor account-specific ABM plays using provided templates and messaging frameworks.
Customize persona-based outreach sequences and messaging for specific territories and strategic accounts.
Maintain and continuously refine Sales Navigator filters to ensure the right personas and accounts stay in focus.
Build and maintain relationship maps at the opportunity and account level to track influence, organizational structure, and decision pathways.
Ensure all relevant contacts are captured, enriched, and updated within Salesforce.
Manage account specific paperflite landing pages for prospect accounts
Discovery Support & Insight Capture
Participate in early discovery calls (typically led by the AVP) to gather essential account context, pain points, and opportunity signals.
Take clear, structured notes and capture the information required to satisfy discovery-stage exit criteria.
Conduct light pre-call research to support AVP preparation and call strategy.
Sales Enablement & Collateral Preparation
Create v1 slideware or call prep materials using approved templates and automation tools for Qualify and Discovery conversations.

Experience & Skills
2–5 years in business development, inside sales, account development, sales support, or SDR roles — preferably in B2B enterprise software, healthcare, or complex technical sales environments.
Demonstrated success securing meetings, activating dormant accounts, or advancing early-stage pipeline.
Proficiency with Salesforce, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and outbound sequencing/cadence tools.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills; comfortable reaching out to new stakeholders and handling gatekeepers.
Strong organization and note-taking skills; able to manage multiple accounts and opportunities simultaneously.
High resilience, persistence, and comfort engaging in outbound motions.
Ability to understand complex healthcare operations concepts (training provided, but curiosity is required).

You will be responsible for converting high-intent inbound marketing leads into long-term clients, driving core growth across our key revenue segment.

Rather than building bespoke proposals for every opportunity, the Business Development Manager sells from a defined package portfolio, allowing them to manage a high volume of opportunities efficiently while delivering a consistent customer experience.

End-to-End Pipeline Ownership: Manage the full sales cycle from initial inbound inquiry through to contract execution and client onboarding.
Lead Qualification & Discovery: Evaluate inbound marketing opportunities against ideal customer profiles (ICP) to assess fit and commercial value.
Product Demonstrations: Conduct compelling discovery calls and engage prospects with tailored product demonstrations.
Package Presentation: Match prospect needs with predefined solution packages (hardware, software, payments) to drive fast decision-making and rapid implementation.
Commercial Negotiation: Confidently manage objections, present commercial proposals, and close new business to meet or exceed targets.
CRM & Pipeline Hygiene: Maintain accurate, real-time records in the CRM to ensure accurate revenue forecasting and pipeline tracking.
Target Achievement: Consistently deliver against core sales metrics, including revenue targets, conversion rates, and activity KPIs.
And a little bit of....
Contributing as part of the wider team to achieve organisational objectives even if this means doing things that aren’t strictly within the scope of your role.

Collaborative and solution-focused, with a strategic mindset and the resilience to navigate challenges and drive results.
Proven track record in an end-to-end sales role (closing deals independently without relying on separate SDR/AE splits).
Comfort managing multiple opportunities simultaneously in a fast-paced inbound environment.
Ability to qualify leads quickly, uncover core customer pain points, and align them with structured product packages.
Prior experience selling integrated tech solutions (hardware, SaaS, or payment/fintech platforms) is highly desirable.
Excellent commercial acumen with a history of hitting and exceeding quota targets.
CRM Mastery: Strong discipline with pipeline management and CRM tools (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot).
What's in it for you?
You will learn everything about us, our story, the colleagues, our workflow and you will receive a practical onboarding. We have the ability to move fast like an innovative start-up with the expertise and capabilities of a global scale-up. The result: a team of both new and experienced professionals led by supportive and approachable managers who recognise and reward your work.
You will be part of a team that likes to work together, help each other, share insights and achieve success. Before you know it, we'll be celebrating your first deal together!
Come live the Lightspeed experience...
Genuine career opportunities in a company that’s creating new jobs every day;
Work in a team big enough for growth but lean enough to make a real impact.
… and enjoy a range of benefits that’ll keep you happy, healthy, and (not) hungry:
Lightspeed share scheme (we are all owners)
Company pension program

Flexible PTO
Mental health online platform and counselling & coaching services
Paid leave and assistance for new parents
Language classes & LinkedIn Learning license
Volunteer day

Lightspeed is a proud equal opportunity employer and we are committed to creating an inclusive and barrier-free workplace. Lightspeed welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.
Where to from here?
Obviously, this has to be mutually beneficial: we want you to step into a role you love, and we want to offer you a place you’re proud to come to every day. For a glimpse into our world check out our career page here .
Lightspeed is building communities through commerce, and we need people from all backgrounds and lived experiences to do that. We were founded in 2005, in Montreal’s gay village and our original members were all part of the LGBTQ+ community. The ethos of our business has been about inclusion from the very beginning, and we strive to provide a workplace where everyone belongs.

Powering the businesses that are the backbone of the global economy, Lightspeed's one-stop commerce platform helps merchants innovate to simplify, scale, and provide exceptional customer experiences. Our cloud commerce solution transforms and unifies online and physical operations, multichannel sales, expansion to new locations, global payments, financial solutions, and connection to supplier networks.
Founded in Montréal, Canada in 2005, Lightspeed is dual-listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: LSPD) and Toronto Stock Exchange (TSX: LSPD). With teams across North America, Europe, and Asia Pacific, the company serves retail, hospitality, and golf businesses in over 100 countries.

Crecimiento (Upgrades +20%)

Generar el crecimiento del proyecto con un objetivo de un 20% sobre el scope actual del mismo.
Aumentar su Tier dentro de la compañía.

Alta capacidad de negociación.
Excelentes habilidades comunicativas.
Conocimiento de negocios en diferentes sectores e identificación de oportunidades a partir del análisis del negocio con los datos que ya tenemos del mismo.
Carácter autodidacta y capacidad de aprendizaje rápido .
Capacidad de priorización y organización. Necesitarás saber priorizar los proyectos, generar acciones con los equipos internos y liderar las propuestas.
Capacidad de autogestión y autonomía .
Responsabilidad y proactividad.
Mentalidad de winner y capacidad de motivar al equipo. El equipo tiene que creer en la oportunidad e impulsarla para que suceda.
Saber dar ayuda y recibirla por parte de los compañeros.
Obsesión por la excelencia .
Compromiso en el trabajo.

Conocimientos técnicos de Data, Adquisición, CRM y Growth. No trabajarás la parte técnica pero necesitas tener el conocimiento suficiente para liderar conversaciones de negociación e identificar las necesidades reales del cliente.
Conocimiento sobre la Inteligencia Artificial y cómo podemos a través de ella mejorar en las oportunidades de los clientes.
Residencia en España: Es imprescindible que residas en territorio nacional.

Necesitamos que tengas disponibilidad para desplazarte a reuniones presenciales con clientes (allí donde estén) o a nuestras oficinas cuando la estrategia lo requiera.

Conocimientos en Marketing y/o Growth.

NetBox Labs is seeking a Channel Account Manager (CAM) to play a key role in the growth and expansion of our partner business. You will report to the VP of Partnerships. Your mandate is simple to state and demanding to execute: drive NetBox Labs revenue by making our partners a force multiplier for our sales team.

That means hunting for partner opportunities, owning a partner-sourced pipeline, and expanding and deepening our existing partner relationships. This requires you to enable partner sellers to find, position, and win with NetBox Labs across our critical VAR, SI, and Technology Partner channels, from large national VARs to strong regional players.

We are looking for a hungry, high-energy doer; the person who makes things happen. The right candidate is a proven self-starter with initiative and self-sufficiency: someone who builds their own plan, creates their own momentum, and delivers results without waiting for direction.
Two things make this seat distinctive. First, the motion: this is a scaling business with real deal flow, a very active, fast-moving environment closing dozens of deals every quarter. As our platform adds new features and capabilities, we are winning larger and more complex enterprise deals.

You need to keep pace with today’s velocity and bring the experience to help us win upmarket. Second, the team: our sales organization is early in its career and growing fast. We need a CAM whose experience raises the whole team's game; co-selling, coaching deal strategy, and sharing hard-won channel craft.

Everything at NetBox Labs is new, and it changes daily. This role rewards curiosity, adaptability, and the commitment to put in the time to master our platform, our open source community, and our market. Experience here is a foundation to build on — never a playbook to coast on.
In this role you will
Hunt for revenue: prospect relentlessly for new opportunities within and alongside our partners; work with partner sellers and our sales organization to uncover, register, and advance deals in their account bases, bringing the same drive to partner-sourced pipeline that a top seller brings to net-new logos.
Selectively expand the partner portfolio: we are always open to new partners, especially large ones, but our team is lean and we qualify rigorously. Evaluate inbound and prospective partners with discipline, and work with the partner team to onboard only those that meaningfully strengthen our coverage.
Map and develop relationships within the Partner Field and Field Technical organizations: relentlessly discover new contacts, turn them into Champions for NetBox Labs, and convert those relationships into sales opportunities.
Own the number: build, forecast, and be accountable for a robust pipeline of Partner Sourced sales opportunities, and co-sell alongside our Account Executives to move deals from registration to close — at the pace our deal flow demands.
Coach as you close: co-sell with our Account Executives, run deal reviews, and share your channel knowledge and deal instincts that only experience teaches.
Drive joint go-to-market execution: build partner business plans, launch sales campaigns and enablement with partners, and hold both sides accountable for pipeline commitments.
Facilitate the effective and efficient interaction of NetBox Labs field and field technical teams with their counterparts at our partner organizations. Develop and maintain executive relationships with assigned Partners.
Learn relentlessly: invest the time to master the NetBox Labs platform, our open source ecosystem, and the network automation market — and keep learning as the product, the motion, and the market change week to week.
Keep Partner and Partner Deal information accurate and up to date within our CRM system. Provide accurate and timely reporting on key partner indicators and metrics.

Minimum of 3 – 5 years of channel sales experience, with a strong emphasis on managing Value-Added Resellers (VARs), SIs, Boutique consulting firms, and Technology partners in the B2B high-tech space (SaaS, networking, Infrastructure, cybersecurity, etc.).
Proven success in growing and managing a portfolio of partners with a measurable revenue impact: you can point to the pipeline you sourced and deals you helped close.
A strong sales orientation and hunter mentality: hungry, energetic, and treats partner recruitment and pipeline generation the way a quota-carrying seller treats their number.
A demonstrated self-starter who shows initiative and self-sufficiency: you thrive with autonomy, create your own structure, and do not need hand-holding to deliver results.
Range across deal types: you thrive in a very active, fast-moving, deal-rich environment, and you have the skills and mindset for larger, multi-stakeholder enterprise deals as that mix grows.
A coach’s mindset: genuine enjoyment in collaborating with sellers; you measure your impact in the team’s numbers, not just your own.
Learning agility: you quickly master new products, ecosystems, and markets, and you are energized, not exhausted, by an environment where everything is new and changes daily.
Start-up attitude: Ability to prioritize and act on the most important activities while working as a team to respond. Collaboration/coordination with your peers is the key to success. We are extremely fast paced.
Embrace AI: Leveraging AI to accelerate partnerships and add efficiency to your activities will be key. AI allows us to move / respond quickly.
In-depth understanding of partner business models, and sales cycles for a wide variety of partners.
Experience with partner tools including PRM systems, CRM (Hubspot preferred), and deal registration platforms.
Excellent interpersonal and negotiation skills with the ability to influence Partner executives, sales reps, and technical stakeholders.

Experience across the VAR landscape, including large national VARs, regional VARs, and SI/Consulting partners.
Technical background or experience in networking, enterprise IT, cloud infrastructure, or security.
Startup experience at an organization experiencing hypergrowth.
Knowledge or background with partners in Networking, Network Engineering, and/or Network Automation would be a significant advantage.

NetBox Labs helps companies build and manage complex networks. We help customers accelerate network automation by delivering open, composable products and supporting the network automation community.
NetBox Labs is the commercial steward of open source NetBox, the world’s most popular network source of truth, and Orb, the next-generation open source network observability platform. Our products include NetBox Enterprise, a fully supported self-managed NetBox with advanced features, and NetBox Cloud, a secure, scalable, and reliable SaaS edition of NetBox.
NetBox powers thousands of companies, and NetBox Labs is backed by investment from Notable Capital (formerly GGV), Grafana Labs CEO Raj Dutt, Flybridge, IBM, Salesforce Ventures, and Mango Capital.

s.h: Dans ce contexte, nous recherchons un(e)
s.t:
## **Key Account Manager / Business Developer (80-100 %)** ##
**Poste basé à Lausanne | Secteur : Vaud - Neuchâtel | CDI | Entrée en fonction : à convenir**
### Votre mission ###
* Conquérir de nouveaux clients, développer le potentiel de notre portefeuille existant et générer une croissance durable dans nos trois domaines : solutions digitales pour la construction et l-immobilier (AEC), impression (PRINT), communication visuelle et signalétique (ADVERTISING).
* Présent(e) sur le terrain, vous développez votre réseau, identifiez de nouvelles opportunités et accompagnez nos clients dans leurs projets, principalement sur Vaud et Neuchâtel, avec un potentiel de développement sur Fribourg.
* Vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec nos équipes techniques et opérationnelles afin de construire des solutions adaptées aux besoins de chaque client et de vous concentrer sur le développement commercial.
## Vos responsabilités ##
* Prospecter activement et conquérir de nouveaux clients.
* Développer stratégiquement les comptes existants et identifier de nouveaux potentiels de chiffre d-affaires.
* Identifier les projets, besoins, opportunités et principaux décideurs.
* Développer les opportunités de cross-selling entre nos activités AEC, PRINT et ADVERTISING.
* Piloter l-ensemble du cycle commercial, de l-analyse des besoins à la négociation et à la conclusion des affaires.
* Construire et entretenir des relations durables avec les décideurs et interlocuteurs clés.
* Gérer activement votre pipeline commercial, assurer un suivi rigoureux dans le CRM et contribuer aux prévisions de ventes.
## Votre profil ##
* Expérience confirmée en vente B2B, Business Development ou gestion de comptes, avec une pratique concrète de la prospection et de l-acquisition.
* Solide tempérament commercial, goût du terrain, sens de la négociation et forte orientation résultats.
* Capacité à comprendre les enjeux clients, identifier les potentiels de développement et construire des relations commerciales durables.
* Personnalité autonome, engagée et structurée, avec un excellent relationnel et un réel esprit collaboratif.
* Vous résidez à Lausanne ou à proximité et connaissez bien l-environnement économique régional.
* Une expérience dans la vente de solutions ou de services, dans un environnement B2B à forte composante conseil, constitue un réel atout.
* La connaissance d-un ou plusieurs de nos domaines AEC, PRINT ou ADVERTISING constitue un avantage, sans être indispensable.
* Parfaite maîtrise du français ; anglais et/ou allemand, un atout.
* Permis de conduire indispensable.
## Ce que nous vous offrons ##
* Une large autonomie dans l-organisation et le développement de votre secteur.
* Un portefeuille clients existant offrant un réel potentiel de développement et de cross-selling.
* La force d-un groupe présent dans toute la Suisse, combinée à la proximité et à l-expertise de nos équipes régionales.
* Une collaboration étroite avec nos équipes techniques et opérationnelles pour construire des solutions adaptées aux besoins des clients.
* Une formation complète à nos solutions, métiers et outils.
* Du télétravail possible après une période d-intégration.
* Un package comprenant salaire fixe, rémunération variable et participation aux frais de véhicule.
**Vous aimez conquérir de nouveaux clients, développer un portefeuille et construire des relations commerciales durables ?**
Rejoignez-nous et contribuez activement au développement de nos activités en Suisse romande.
**Seules les candidatures correspondant au profil recherché seront contactées pour la suite du processus.**
*Agences de placement : merci de vous abstenir.*

Wir suchen dich! Unternehmen erwarten heute, dass ihre Kunden schnell den richtigen Ansprechpartner erreichen und Anliegen ohne Umwege geklärt werden können. Genau dabei unterstützen wir sie.
Für den Ausbau unseres Vertriebs suchen wir einen Account Executive (m/w/d) , der neue Kunden gewinnt und sie dabei begleitet, ihre Kundenkommunikation einfacher, effizienter und besser zu gestalten.
Du arbeitest dich gerne in die Abläufe und Herausforderungen eines Unternehmens ein, bevor du über Produkte sprichst? Du führst Gespräche auf Augenhöhe, denkst in Lösungen und möchtest aktiv zum Wachstum eines Unternehmens beitragen? Dann suchen wir dich.
Wir arbeiten hybrid, mit klaren Zuständigkeiten und engem Austausch im Team.
Deine Aufgaben Du gewinnst neue Kunden und begleitest sie vom Erstgespräch bis zum Vertragsabschluss.
Du führst strukturierte Bedarfsanalysen durch und verstehst, wie Kundenkommunikation im Unternehmen heute funktioniert und wo Verbesserungsbedarf besteht.
Du berätst Entscheider bei der Auswahl einer passenden Lösung für Telefonie, Erreichbarkeit und Kundenservice.
Du führst Produktdemonstrationen durch, die auf den jeweiligen Anwendungsfall zugeschnitten sind.
Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit unserem Technik-Team Lösungsansätze für komplexere Anforderungen.
Du begleitest Ausschreibungen und Auswahlprozesse, auch wenn mehrere Entscheider beteiligt sind.

Magnet Forensics is a global leader in the development of digital investigative software that acquires, analyzes, and shares evidence from computers, smartphones, tablets, and IoT-related devices. Serving thousands of customers globally, our solutions are playing a crucial role in modernizing digital investigations, helping investigators fight crime, protect assets, and guard national security.
With employees based around the world, Magnet Forensics has been expanding our global presence. As a part of Magnet Forensics, you can expect to make a difference in the world, no matter what role you play. You’ll be supported through learning and development, not to mention an incredible team with unbelievable talent and integrity.
If you think you would be the right person to join our team working towards this goal, we would love to hear from you!

The Account Manager is responsible for developing and expanding relationships with existing customers, ensuring customer success, maximizing the value customers realize from Magnet Forensics’ solutions, and identifying opportunities to grow customer adoption across our portfolio of products and services.

We’re looking for someone who checks off most, but not all, of the boxes listed in “skills and experiences”. How We Work

If you’re within a comfortable travel distance to one of our offices, you’ll occasionally join us in person. How often you’ll come in depends on your department and team needs, typically ranging from weekly to monthly.

About Magic
Magic is a leading modern outsourcing platform that connects SMBs to high-quality remote workers, from SDRs to virtual assistants and more. With roots in Silicon Valley, and backing from top venture capitalists, our workers are supercharged with a combination of the latest AI technology and training.
Role Purpose
We are seeking experienced and driven Business Development Managers (Account Executives) who are passionate about helping fast-growing businesses achieve their goals. As a BDM, you will own the end-to-end sales cycle—from initial outreach and discovery to closing and onboarding—while consistently creating value and fostering lasting client relationships.
We will give you 50+ warm inbound leads per month. Your job? Own them. All the way. From discovery to close, from "not now" to "let's revisit", your success will come from your grit, discipline, curiosity, and accountability. We're looking for high-performing Account Executives who are obsessed with results, coachable to the core, and treat every lead like gold.

Own the full sales cycle from inbound discovery to follow-up, closing, and successful onboarding, ensuring a smooth transition for new clients and hitting quota monthly
Run 15+ discovery calls per week with C-level and Director-level prospects; uncover pain, establish urgency, and align the right product
Know when to position which Magic product by becoming a true product expert and match offerings to prospect needs with precision
Treat every lead like a win waiting to happen by working “not now” leads with discipline and creativity until the timing is right
Work every deal to completion and don’t let momentum die; follow up persistently, update next steps, and never lose track of potential
Own your pipeline like a pro while keeping HubSpot clean, prioritize outreach, and maintain deal velocity at all times
Collaborate with Sales, Support, and Ops Teams to ensure clients start strong and are set up for long-term success
Share what’s working and learn what’s not bringing a growth mindset to every deal, and adapt quickly when SOPs, experiments, or strategies evolve
Continuously learn and improve, seeking feedback, applying it fast, and treating personal growth like part of the job
Stay consistent, stay hungry while showing up with energy, drive, and the mindset that every day is an opportunity to win

You handle 2 to 8 discovery calls per day and never drop the ball
You don’t let soft “no's” die. You work the deal until the answer is final
You actively ask, “What could I do better?” and apply the feedback fast
You own your pipeline like you personally paid for the lead. Every lead, every stage, is tracked and followed up on
You’re not waiting for opportunities, you’re creating them in your pipeline

s.t:
You blame the leads, the tools, or the process, rather than asking what you could do better

You don’t take the initiative to improve; you wait for someone to tell you what to fix
You treat “bad timing” or “not now” as dead ends instead of future wins to nurture

Company Overview: Makina, a crypto-native organization of builders and DeFi leaders, is seeking a full-time Business Development Manager. This is an excellent opportunity to join a dynamic and fast-growing team focused on building trust-minimized infrastructure for the next generation of onchain strategies.
Makina introduces a novel framework for onchain asset management that addresses a significant gap in the decentralized finance (DeFi) ecosystem. While DeFi has successfully replicated many traditional financial primitives, asset management remains underdeveloped, and sophisticated yielding strategies are not broadly available to users across the space. Makina provides a highly adaptable and secure architecture designed to facilitate a broad spectrum of strategies.
Job Summary: We are seeking a full-time Growth & Business Development Manager to take ownership of the strategy, execution, and growth of Makina’s partnerships, integrations, and presence in the American market. This role requires deep DeFi expertise, a robust network, and a proven track record of closing high-value deals. The ideal candidate is both a strategic thinker and hands-on operator, capable of driving business development in a fast-paced, innovative environment.

Identify, evaluate, and prioritize potential DeFi partners (protocols, DAOs, liquidity providers, and institutional players) that align with the protocol’s goals.
Manage the lifecycle of partnerships, from initial outreach to closing and ongoing relationship management.
Market & Ecosystem Expansion
Map and analyze the DeFi landscape to spot emerging trends, new protocols, and innovative business opportunities for Makina.
Develop and execute go-to-market strategies to expand Makina’s reach and drive adoption.
Represent the protocol at major events, forums, and governance discussions to build brand presence and source new opportunities.
TVL growth strategy
Develop and execute comprehensive strategies to grow Makina’s Total Value Locked (TVL) by attracting both retail and institutional capital.
Monitor TVL metrics, analyze user behavior, and leverage data-driven insights to optimize growth tactics and address potential barriers to capital inflow.
Build relationships with institutional players to onboard large-scale liquidity.

Proven ability to source, diligence, and close high-value partnerships.
Crypto-native level industry knowledge as well as expert-level knowledge of DeFi protocols, crypto ecosystems, and emerging trends in the space.
Previous experience in a Business Development team, ideally in DeFi.
Ability to work autonomously and to be responsible for achieving the desired results while also contributing to the success of projects shared by the wider team.
Strong project management skills and the ability to manage high-value relationships with key external stakeholders.
Entrepreneurial mindset with a capacity for independent and flexible thinking.
Integrity, humility, intellectual curiosity, honesty, and forthright communication. We are a team of open-minded intellectuals who utilize a dialectical approach to arrive at what is true.
Fluency in English.

The ability to support Makina's key business development tasks described above.
3+ years of experience in an ecosystem partnerships role for a DeFi project, either as a manager or individual contributor.
Established network of high-potential partners that could be accretive to Makina's strategies and/or community.
A strong focus on / presence in the US market, specifically New York.
Demonstrated expertise in growth hacking to optimize and expand sales funnels.
Strong quantitative and analytical skills. Data-science, coding, cryptography, or a technical background is considered an asset.

Dynamic and collegiality in a small team working in fields that are shaping the future of our society.
As a modern employer, we offer you contemporary working conditions, ample space to develop yourself alongside the company, and exciting and challenging projects.
Competitive compensation, bonuses, and participation opportunities.
Exposure to extremely talented people and very interesting clients who have unique investment profiles.
Supportive work and team atmosphere with flat hierarchies and a strong entrepreneurial spirit.

E-commerce is booming — but independent brands still struggle to match the seamless logistics of giants like Amazon. At Bigblue , we’re on a mission to change that.
We help brands by democratizing best-in-class operations: scaling faster while delivering a five-star customer experience.
Since 2018, we’ve built a tech-driven logistics platform powering 500+ brands — from fast-growing DTC players to global names like MUJI, Aigle, and Cabaïa . With 200+ employees across Paris, Madrid, Berlin and London , our proprietary WMS (Warehouse Management System) Atlas , and a network of 10 warehouses across Europe , we’re solving logistics challenges that others haven’t dared to tackle — making fulfillment faster, smarter, and greener .
Backed by $20+M in funding and trusted by the next generation of e-commerce leaders, we’re scaling rapidly — from 10 million orders in 2024 toward ambitious enterprise expansion.
The journey ahead is bold, and we’re looking for the right partner to help us lead the way.

About Fresha
Fresha is the AI-powered operating system for the global beauty, wellness and self-care industry, connecting and powering everything from salons and barbers to spas, medspas, fitness studios and health practices.
Trusted by millions of consumers and businesses worldwide. Fresha is used by 140,000+ businesses and 450,000+ stylists and professionals worldwide, processing over 1 billion appointments to date.
The company is headquartered in London, United Kingdom, with 15 global offices located across North America, EMEA and APAC.
Fresha allows consumers to discover, book and pay for beauty and wellness appointments with local businesses via its marketplace, while beauty and wellness businesses and professionals use an all-in-one platform to manage their entire operations with an intuitive business software and financial technology solutions.
Fresha’s ecosystem gives merchants everything they need to run their business seamlessly by facilitating appointment bookings, point-of-sale, customer records management, marketing automation, loyalty, beauty products inventory and team management.
The consumer marketplace unlocks revenue potential for partner businesses by leveraging the power of online bookings and automated marketing through mobile apps and advanced integrations with major tech brands including Instagram, Facebook and Google.

Relationship Building

Advisor - Advising Partners on suitable product selection based on their needs and specifications.
Business Partnering - Ensure a strong Partner Experience through building relationships by attending video meetings with your pool of Partners and effectively communicating the Fresha features and benefits.
Relationships - Build key internal relationships with our Sales and Onboarding teams to ensure smooth transition and handover of Partners through the Partner journey.
Collaboration - Collaborate with our Product teams to provide important product feedback to help enhance future releases.
Persuasion - Use consultative sales techniques to understand customer needs and requirements and have the ability to upsell and cross-sell the Fresha Platform.
This list is not exhaustive and there may be other activities you are required to deliver.

Experience - 3+ Years experience in effectively delivering commercial outcomes from a previous Account Management role
Adaptability - Shown to be commercially motivated with an ability to adapt and achieve targets
Analytics - Proven experience in using and analysing data and reporting effectively to improve commercial outcomes
Curiosity - Naturally proactive and inquisitive, with a desire to consistently learn and improve

Communication - Excellent and proven written, verbal and presentation skills
Innovative - Creative thinking and problem-solving mindset

Team Player - Happy to roll sleeves up and assist the team when required
Initiative - Ability to self-starter with a proactive approach
Bi-lingual - Fluency in English and French

Beauty & Wellness - Experience within the beauty and wellness industry

Für unseren Kunden, ein international tätiges Unternehmen im Bereich Elektronik und Elektrotechnik, suchen wir per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung einen Key Account Manager (a) für die Region Zürich. Gesucht wird eine verkaufsstarke Persönlichkeit mit technischer Ausbildung in Elektronik oder Elektrotechnik sowie mehrjähriger Vertriebserfahrung im industriellen Umfeld. Die Position bietet abwechslungsreiche Aufgaben, viel Gestaltungsspielraum und attraktive Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten.
## Job Description ##
* Aufbau und nachhaltige Weiterentwicklung eines Kundenportfolios innerhalb der Bahn- und Transportindustrie mit Fokus auf langfristige Partnerschaften und individuelle Lösungen.
* Aktive Erschliessung neuer Marktpotenziale, Gewinnung von Neukunden sowie strategischer Ausbau bestehender Geschäftsbeziehungen.

* Kompetente Beratung von Kunden in technischen Fragestellungen sowie aktive Begleitung von Ausschreibungs- und Vergabeprozessen.
## The Successful Applicant ##
* Erfolgreich abgeschlossene technische Ausbildung im Bereich Elektrotechnik, Automation oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung, ergänzt durch eine betriebswirtschaftliche Weiterbildung.
* Verkaufsstarke und kundenorientierte Persönlichkeit mit fundierter Erfahrung im technischen Vertrieb, idealerweise im Umfeld von Bahntechnik, Mobilität oder Transportlösungen.
* Hohe Eigenverantwortung, unternehmerisches Denken sowie eine strukturierte und zielgerichtete Arbeitsweise zeichnen Sie aus.
* Kommunikationsstarke und teamorientierte Persönlichkeit mit überzeugendem Auftreten und ausgeprägter Fähigkeit, langfristige Kundenbeziehungen aufzubauen.
* Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift; Französischkenntnisse sind ein zusätzliches Plus.

s.t:
Our Operating Principles
Extreme Ownership
We take full responsibility for our work, outcomes, and team success. No excuses, no blame-shifting — if something needs fixing, we own it and make it better. This means stepping up, even when it’s not “your job.” If a ball is dropped, we pick it up. If a customer is unhappy, we fix it. If a process is broken, we redesign it. We don’t wait for someone else to solve it — we lead with accountability and expect the same from those around us.
Craftsmanship
Putting care and intention into every task, striving for excellence, and taking deep ownership of the quality and outcome of your work. Craftsmanship means never settling for “just fine.” We sweat the details because details compound. Whether it’s a product feature, an internal doc, or a sales call — we treat it as a reflection of our standards. We aim to deliver jaw-dropping customer experiences by being curious, meticulous, and proud of what we build — even when nobody’s watching.
We are “majos”
Be friendly & have fun with your coworkers. Always be genuine & honest, but kind. “Majo” is our way of saying: be a good human. Be approachable, helpful, and warm. We’re building something ambitious, and it’s easier (and more fun) when we enjoy the ride together. We give feedback with kindness, challenge each other with respect, and celebrate wins together without ego.
Urgency with Focus
Create the highest impact in the shortest amount of time. Move fast, but in the right direction. We operate with speed because time is our most limited resource. But speed without focus is chaos. We prioritize ruthlessly, act decisively, and stay aligned. We aim for high leverage: the biggest results from the simplest, smartest actions. We’re running a high-speed marathon — not a sprint with no strategy.
Talent Density and Meritocracy
Hire only people who can raise the average; ‘exceptional performance is the passing grade.’ Ability trumps seniority. We believe the best teams are built on talent density — every hire should raise the bar. We reward contribution, not titles or tenure. We give ownership to those who earn it, and we all hold each other to a high standard. A-players want to work with other A-players — that’s how we win.
First-Principles Thinking
Strip a problem to physics-level facts, ignore industry dogma, rebuild the solution from scratch. We don’t copy-paste solutions. We go back to basics, ask why things are the way they are, and rebuild from the ground up if needed. This mindset pushes us to innovate, challenge stale assumptions, and move faster than incumbents. It’s how we build what others think is impossible.

Unsere Kund:innen entscheiden sehr wirtschaftlich – umso wichtiger ist es, den Nutzen unserer Plattform in klare, nachvollziehbare Zahlen zu übersetzen: weniger manueller Aufwand, weniger rechtliches Risiko, messbare Kostenersparnis.

Du baust Vertrauen auf, indem du Erfahrungen unserer Referenzkund:innen teilst – darunter 14 der Top-20-Bauunternehmen Deutschlands – da persönliche Beziehungen und Referenzen in der Baubranche besonders viel zählen.

The World Economic Forum, committed to improving the state of the world, is the international organization for public-private cooperation. The Forum engages the foremost political, business and other leaders of society to shape global, regional and industry agendas.
**Why we are recruiting**
As a partnership organization and through the Business Engagement teams, the World Economic Forum engages the private sector to address industry, regional and systemic issues. Partners benefit from and contribute to the global knowledge base through working closely with the Forum to set the intellectual agenda of Forum gatherings, drive the insight agenda of its publications and steer the impact of its initiatives.
Structured geographically, the Regional Business Team is responsible for building and managing the world-s premier communities of business executives.
We are currently seeking an Account Manager, Africa, who will be tasked manage a portfolio of Partner accounts and engage relevant executives in the Forum-s events, initiatives and communities. The Account Manager will serve as the primary point of contact for assigned organizations; develop and implement engagement strategies that strengthen relationships with CEOs and C-suite executives and identify opportunities to strengthen the engagement with the Forum.
The Account Manager will interact with the Regional Head and across multiple teams ranging from Centres, Business Operations, other regions and industries, Government engagement among others. The person will report to Head of Business Engagement, Africa.

* **Partner (Account) relationship management**: Build and maintain trusted relationships with senior Partner representatives; lead regular engagement with Partners to understand their strategic priorities; collaborate with relevant internal stakeholders to deliver a seamless Partner experience. Engage partners in relevant industry work.
* **Portfolio growth and account management****:** Monitor Partner engagement, business developments and overall account health to identify opportunities for partnership growth and expansion; proactively identify partnership risks and develop retention strategies in collaboration with the Head of Region/Industry to maximize long-term Partner value.
* **Executive engagement and event strategy**: Develop engagement strategies for Partners; shape executive agendas and identify opportunities for speaking roles and leadership interactions and ensure effective follow-up to maximize engagement outcomes.
* **Cross-functional collaboration**: Work closely with Industry, Regional, Centre, Event, Finance and Partner Development (sales) teams to coordinate Partner activities; provide strategic guidance to Account Associates on operational delivery and ensure high-quality execution across the Partner lifecycle.
**Success in this role will be measured by:**
* **Partner engagement**: Strong and trusted relationships with senior executives, reflected in sustained engagement across Forum activities.
* **Partner retention**: High retention rates and proactive management of at-risk accounts through effective engagement strategies.
* **Strategic execution**: Delivery of high-quality engagement plans and successful execution of Partner strategies aligned with organizational priorities.
* **Collaboration and leadership**: Effective coordination across internal teams, enabling a seamless Partner experience and consistent knowledge sharing.

* Bachelor's degree (or equivalent) in Business, Economics, International Relations, Management or another relevant field.
* Knowledge and understanding of the business, economic and political landscape of Africa
* 5+ years of experience in account management, client relationship management, business development or a similar external-facing role
* Demonstrated experience managing relationships with senior business executives and navigating complex stakeholder environments.
* Strong commercial acumen with the ability to identify growth opportunities and develop long-term engagement strategies.
* Excellent relationship-building, communication and influencing skills, with the ability to engage confidently with C-suite executives.
* Strong organizational, project management and prioritization skills, with the ability to manage multiple strategic accounts simultaneously.
* Proven ability to work collaboratively across multidisciplinary and multicultural teams while balancing strategic thinking with execution.
* Responsible, self-driven and adaptable, with a learning mindset and a strong commitment to delivering exceptional Partner experiences.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and Salesforce (or other CRM platforms); experience leveraging AI-enabled productivity tools is an asset.
